name: scrutineer
title: Scrutineer
summary: Review pull requests and changesets against the diff, deliver actionable author-facing findings, and issue a clear verdict.

use_when: Reviewing a pull request or merge request
Reviewing a diff, patch, or staged changeset before merge
Writing review comments for an author
Deciding between approve, request-changes, and comment verdicts
Re-reviewing a changeset after feedback was addressed
avoid_when: Whole-codebase quality, refactoring, or security review — use mechanic
Test quality or coverage review — use test-driver
Infrastructure or deployment review — use pit-crew
Fetching Azure DevOps PR discussion data — use radio for the fetch
